title: 微软前任 CEO 如何向员工介绍接班人（2014）
topic: 微软前任 CEO 如何向员工介绍接班人（2014）

source.title: Steve Ballmer email to employees on new CEO - Source
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: From: Steve Ballmer To: All Employees Date: Feb. 4, 2014 Subject: Satya Nadella – Microsoft’s New CEO

Today is an incredibly exciting day as we announce Satya Nadella as the new CEO of Microsoft. Satya will be a great CEO, and I am pumped for the future of Microsoft. You can read the full announcement here.

Satya is a proven leader. He’s got strong technical skills and great business insights. He has a remarkable ability to see what’s going on in the market, to sense opportunity, and to really understand how we come together at Microsoft to execute against those opportunities in a collaborative way. I have worked closely with Satya for many years and I have seen these skills many times. He is not alone, though. Our Senior Leadership Team has never been stronger, and together this group will drive us forward.

Microsoft is one of the great companies in the world. I love this company. I love the bigness and boldness of what we do. I love the way we partner with other companies to come together to change the world. I love the breadth and the diversity of all of the customers we empower, from students in the classroom to consumers to small businesses to governments to the largest enterprises.
translations: 发件人：史蒂夫·鲍尔默 收件人：全体员工 日期：2014年2月4日 主题：萨提亚·纳德拉——微软新任首席执行官
今天是一个令人振奋的日子，我们宣布萨提亚·纳德拉担任微软新任 CEO。萨提亚会是一位出色的 CEO，我对微软的未来感到非常振奋。完整公告可在此处阅读。
萨提亚是一位经实践证明的领导者。他技术扎实，商业洞察力出色。他善于洞察市场、发现机会，也真正了解微软团队如何协作，把握并推进这些机会。我与萨提亚共事多年，多次亲眼见证这些能力。不过他并非孤军奋战：我们的高级领导团队空前强大，大家会共同推动公司向前发展。
微软是世界上最优秀的公司之一。我热爱这家公司，也热爱我们所做事业的规模与魄力。我热爱我们与其他公司携手改变世界的方式，也热爱我们所服务的客户群体广泛而多元：从课堂里的学生、普通消费者、小型企业和政府，到大型企业。
fullTextParagraphs: From: Steve Ballmer To: All Employees Date: Feb. 4, 2014 Subject: Satya Nadella – Microsoft’s New CEO

Today is an incredibly exciting day as we announce Satya Nadella as the new CEO of Microsoft. Satya will be a great CEO, and I am pumped for the future of Microsoft. You can read the full announcement here.

Satya is a proven leader. He’s got strong technical skills and great business insights. He has a remarkable ability to see what’s going on in the market, to sense opportunity, and to really understand how we come together at Microsoft to execute against those opportunities in a collaborative way. I have worked closely with Satya for many years and I have seen these skills many times. He is not alone, though. Our Senior Leadership Team has never been stronger, and together this group will drive us forward.

Microsoft is one of the great companies in the world. I love this company. I love the bigness and boldness of what we do. I love the way we partner with other companies to come together to change the world. I love the breadth and the diversity of all of the customers we empower, from students in the classroom to consumers to small businesses to governments to the largest enterprises.
Above all, I love the spirit of this place, the passion, and the perseverance, which has been the cornerstone of our culture from the very beginning.
Stay focused and keep moving forward. I am excited about what we will do. Satya’s appointment confirms that.
Thanks for making Microsoft the most amazing place to work on the planet, and thanks for the chance to lead.

notes.phrase: From: Steve Ballmer To: All Employees
notes.meaning: 邮件抬头：发件人、收件人、日期和主题
notes.explain: 邮件抬头帮助读者确认这封信由谁写给谁，以及它讨论什么。
notes.example: From: Maya Chen To: Project Team Date: Oct. 12 Subject: Launch handoff

notes.phrase: I am pumped for the future of Microsoft
notes.meaning: 我对微软的未来感到非常振奋
notes.explain: pumped 在这里是非正式形容词，表达强烈的兴奋和期待；正式邮件可以改用 excited。
notes.example: The team is pumped about the upcoming product launch.

notes.phrase: remarkable ability to see what’s going on in the market, to sense opportunity
notes.meaning: 善于洞察市场动态并发现机会
notes.explain: remarkable 强调能力突出；see what is going on 和 sense opportunity 分别指了解市场情况和察觉机会。
notes.example: She has a remarkable ability to spot customer needs early.

notes.phrase: the breadth and the diversity of all of the customers we empower
notes.meaning: 我们所支持的客户群体范围广、类型多
notes.explain: breadth 指覆盖范围，diversity 指构成多样；这里说的是客户群体，而不是解决方案的种类。
notes.example: The breadth and diversity of our customers shape the way we design support.

scenario.title: Summarize how Ballmer introduced his successor
english: A colleague asks how Steve Ballmer described Satya Nadella when announcing him as Microsoft’s new CEO in 2014.
You highlight Nadella’s technical and business strengths, his understanding of the market, and his ability to bring teams together to pursue opportunities.
Your answer stays close to Ballmer’s original message rather than inventing concerns about the transition.
chinese: 一位同事问，Steve Ballmer 在 2014 年宣布 Satya Nadella 接任微软 CEO 时如何介绍他。
你概括 Nadella 的技术和商业能力、对市场的理解，以及推动团队协作抓住机会的能力。
回答贴近 Ballmer 的原始邮件，不添加交接中的虚构担忧。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事问 Steve Ballmer 在 2014 年宣布 Satya Nadella 接任 CEO 时，怎样介绍他的能力，并怎样表达对微软未来和交接团队的信心。请用英文概括。
firstAttempt.sample: Ballmer described Nadella as a proven leader with strong technical skills and great business insights. He said Microsoft’s senior leadership team would drive the company forward together, and he was excited about the future.
firstAttempt.rationale: 答案同时概括了 Nadella 的能力、领导团队的共同作用，以及 Ballmer 对微软未来的期待；不编造邮件没有提到的交接担忧。

words.meaning: 令人振奋的；令人兴奋的
words.example: The CEO announced several exciting initiatives for the upcoming fiscal year.
words.translation: CEO宣布，下一财年将推出几项令人振奋的新举措。
words.note: 用来描述让人感到兴奋或期待的消息、机会和进展。

words.meaning: 经实践证明的；有实绩支撑的
words.collocation: a proven leader / method / track record
words.example: She has a proven track record of delivering projects on time and under budget.
words.translation: 她有按时并在预算内交付项目的可靠业绩记录。
words.note: 强调能力或方法有实际表现作支撑。

words.example: The market research report provided valuable insights into customer behavior.
words.translation: 市场研究报告提供了关于客户行为的宝贵见解。
words.note: insight 可作可数名词；本句用复数表示多方面的洞察。

words.example: A collaborative approach helped the product and support teams resolve the issue.
words.translation: 通过协作，产品团队和支持团队解决了这个问题。
words.note: 强调不同成员共同推进工作。

words.collocation: show / demonstrate / have the boldness to do something
words.example: The team had the boldness to test a new approach with customers.
words.translation: 团队有魄力向客户测试一种新方法。
words.note: 这里指敢于采取有挑战的行动，不等于鲁莽。

words.example: The service empowers small businesses to manage customer requests.
words.translation: 这项服务帮助小企业管理客户请求。
words.note: 常接人或组织，再接 to do，说明对方因此能做什么。

structure.original: Today is an incredibly exciting day as we announce Satya Nadella as the new CEO of Microsoft.
analysis: 主句“Today is an incredibly exciting day”是主系表结构：Today 作主语，is 是系动词，an incredibly exciting day 作表语。
“as we announce…”是 as 引导的时间从句，表示“在我们宣布……之际”；从句中 we announce Satya Nadella，as the new CEO of Microsoft 补充说明 Nadella 被任命的身份。
注意两个 as 用法不同：前一个连接时间从句，后一个说明职位身份；此处前一个 as 不是因果关系。
structure.transfer: Today marks an important step as we welcome our new project lead.

rewrite.bad: Satya is smart, and we are changing everything. I hope everyone is ready.
rewrite.good: Satya is a proven leader with strong technical skills and business insights. Our senior leadership team will drive Microsoft forward together, and I am excited about what we will do.
rewrite.translation: 萨提亚是一位经实践证明的领导者，技术扎实、商业洞察力出色。微软高级领导团队将共同推动公司前进，我对我们未来的工作感到振奋。
rewrite.pattern: Describe [the successor] as [specific strengths], then explain how [the team] will move forward together.

cloze.prompt: Ballmer described Nadella as a proven ___.
cloze.why: a proven leader 表示有实际表现支撑的领导者。

cloze.prompt: Nadella had strong technical skills and great business ___.
cloze.why: 原文使用复数 insights，表示他有出色的商业洞察。

cloze.prompt: Our Senior Leadership Team will drive us ___.
cloze.why: drive a team or company forward 表示推动团队或公司向前发展。

dictation.text: Satya is a proven leader. He’s got strong technical skills and great business insights.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 介绍纳德拉的能力
dictation.why: 听出 proven leader、technical skills 和 business insights 三项评价。

dictation.text: Our Senior Leadership Team has never been stronger, and together this group will drive us forward.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 团队共同推动公司前进
dictation.why: 听出对领导团队的评价和 together this group will drive us forward 的共同推进关系。

apply.prompt: 用一句英文概括 Ballmer 对纳德拉能力和微软未来团队协作的评价。
apply.sample: Ballmer praised Nadella’s technical skills and business insights, and said the strong leadership team would move Microsoft forward together.

translationPractice.prompt: Ballmer 将 Nadella 描述为一位经实践证明的领导者。
translationPractice.answer: Ballmer described Nadella as a proven leader.
translationPractice.why: describe someone as + 名词/形容词，表示把某人描述为某种人或具有某种特点。

translationPractice.prompt: Ballmer 表示，Nadella 技术扎实，商业洞察力出色。
translationPractice.answer: Ballmer said Nadella had strong technical skills and great business insights.
translationPractice.why: 并列保留两项能力；business insights 使用原文复数形式。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们的高级领导团队会共同推动公司向前发展。
translationPractice.answer: Our senior leadership team will drive the company forward together.
translationPractice.why: drive the company forward 表示推动公司发展，together 表示团队共同完成。

choice.prompt: 以下哪项既概括了 Ballmer 对 Nadella 的能力评价，也表达了他对微软未来团队协作的态度？
options: Ballmer praised Nadella’s technical skills and his ability to help teams act on opportunities, but said he was unsure whether Microsoft could move forward.

Ballmer called Nadella a proven leader with technical and business strengths, described how he could bring teams together around opportunities, and said the leadership team would drive Microsoft forward as he looked ahead with excitement.
Ballmer said the leadership team lacked experience, so Nadella would need to reorganize the company before it could make progress.
choice.why: B includes Nadella’s capabilities, collaborative execution, the strong leadership team, and Ballmer’s excitement about the future. A reverses his confidence; C invents a weak team and an immediate reorganization.

output.prompt: 迁移情境：新任客户运营负责人 Rina 将加入支持与产品团队。请写两句英文介绍她的相关经验，并表达你对跨团队合作的信心。使用明确但不夸大的事实。
output.sample: Rina has a proven record in customer operations and a strong understanding of our support workflows. I’m confident she’ll help support and product work together to improve customer handoffs.
check: 是否写出与客户运营相关的具体经验？
是否说清她将如何帮助支持与产品协作？
是否表达对共同工作的信心？
是否避免虚构与任务无关的履历？
